title: Zesty Dense French Duck Rillettes
description: A winey and dense French dish featuring duck, white chocolate chips, and a papillote cooking method, this sugar-free-friendly recipe is a nostalgic Basque-French delight.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
Season the duck breast with salt, black pepper, and paprika.
In a large Dutch oven, combine the red wine, shallots, garlic, and thyme.
Add the duck breast to the Dutch oven and cover with a papillote.
Bake for 2 1/2 hours or until the duck is tender.
Remove the duck from the oven and let it cool.
Shred the duck into small pieces and mix with white chocolate chips.
Serve the rillettes chilled, garnished with fresh thyme.
Store any leftovers in an airtight container in the refrigerator.
Reheat the rillettes gently before serving.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
